profile.raw_yaml:
# 口径卡（故障注入：优雅停机）：与 fault-kill-node-failfast-v1 的 --variant sigterm（服务端 deregisterGrace = 框架缺省 0）对照，
# 只差 target.server_deregister_grace: 2s（服务端摘注册之后照常处理请求 2s、再开始拒绝新请求，等注册中心把下线推送传到消费端）。
# 故障直接写成 sigterm（这张卡只回答优雅停机的问题）。与 fault-sigterm-grace2s-failover-v1 只差 target.cluster / target.retries。
# 跑法：bench/bin/fault-run.sh --card fault-sigterm-grace2s-failfast-v1（fault-run.sh 按卡片给服务端传 --deregister-grace 2s）。
# 改动口径请复制成新 id（-v2），不要原地改。
profile: fault-sigterm-grace2s-failfast-v1
question: 3 个提供者、开环 5000 req/s，一个节点优雅停机（SIGTERM）且服务端 deregisterGrace = 2s 时，failfast 下是否零错误
target:
  transport: rpc
  service: BenchService#echo
  payload: { kind: bytes, size: 1024 }
  serializer: protobuf
  providers: 3
  load_balance: roundrobin
  cluster: failfast
  retries: 0
  server_deregister_grace: 2s
load:
  model: open
  rate: 5000
  faults:
    - { at: 20s, kind: sigterm, target: 2 }
  duration: 60s
  warmup: 10s
  steady_window: [10s, 60s]
  rounds: 1
  timeout: 1s
isolation:
  client_process: separate_jvm
  server_process: separate_jvm
  same_host: true
  registry: docker-compose/zookeeper（容器未绑核、与压测进程共享宿主核）；toxic-timeout 变体时第 2 个提供者经 toxiproxy 原生进程（同 WSL）
measure:
  histogram: { significant_digits: 3, max: 10s }
  report: [throughput, p50, p99, p999, max, errors_by_status]

run.command: rpc-bench-e2e run --profile /home/yifan/rpc-bench/bench/profiles/fault-sigterm-grace2s-failfast-v1.yaml --registry zk://127.0.0.1:2181 --out /home/yifan/t19/p/sigterm/sigterm-g2s-failfast-on-2 --label outlier-probe --topology /home/yifan/t19/p/sigterm/sigterm-g2s-failfast-on-2/topology.txt --fault-schedule /home/yifan/t19/p/sigterm/sigterm-g2s-failfast-on-2/schedule-140857.txt --open-workers per-request --outlier-detection on --pin-dispatcher 5

target.connection_model: 2 TCP connection(s) per provider, requests multiplexed by request id
target.server_stats_note: window gc / io / backpressure / server_executor come from this provider only (the first address in sorted order); per-provider counters are in rounds[].timeline

scheduler.call_style: sync proxy method on a new virtual thread per request

faults.executor: bench/bin/fault-run.sh (harness writes the schedule, the script executes it and appends <schedule>.executed)

server_environment.gc: G1 Young Generation G1 Concurrent GC G1 Old Generation

server_environment.server_executor: fixed pool (10 threads, queue 1000): business methods run off the IO threads

scheduler.call_style: sync proxy method on a new virtual thread per request

io.source: /proc/self/io (syscr, syscw) + sum of /proc/self/task/*/status (voluntary / nonvoluntary_ctxt_switches), grouped by /proc/self/task/*/comm prefix (by_group), steady window

backpressure.source: server stats (RpcServer.autoReadPauses / outboundOverloadRejections) + harness client (RpcClient.sendBufferRejections / unwritableConnectionSwitches)

server_executor.source: server counters (RpcServer.executorRejections / shutdownRejections / queuedBusinessTasks; queue wait = bench QueueWaitFilter: arrival (IO-thread decode) -> business thread starts the filter chain)

timeline.basis: success / errors / latency by completion time (latency from the scheduled send time, 2 significant digits); node_attempts / retries from the harness RpcClient (attempts incl. retries, by send time); ejected_nodes = providers in outlier ejection at the end of the second, ejections / restores = cumulative outlier ejections / restores at the end of the second; server_* from each provider's counters() sampled every second (delta of two samples)

recovery.criterion: first second s >= floor(event) where errors[s..s+2] == 0; recovery = max(0, s - event); no error at all after the event = 0

summary.selection_rule: 开环：窗口 p99 的中位数那一轮

statements: 开环负载（open）：延迟从计划发出时刻算起，发压端自身的调度滞后（见“发出滞后”列）也计入延迟；发出滞后的 p99 明显大于服务时间时，说明压测端本身成了瓶颈，数字不代表被测服务。
开环调度线程以忙等对齐节拍，独占一个核；本报告的 CPU 亲和见环境表。
非缺省配置：服务端 deregisterGrace = 2s（框架缺省 0）。
错误不计入延迟分布与吞吐；延迟分位数只统计完成时刻落在统计窗口内的成功调用。
validity.topology: client 与 server 是两个独立 JVM，同一台机器（loopback），3 个提供者（[127.0.0.1:19401, 127.0.0.1:19402, 127.0.0.1:19403]），经 zk://127.0.0.1:2181 发现；卡片声明的注册中心：docker-compose/zookeeper（容器未绑核、与压测进程共享宿主核）；toxic-timeout 变体时第 2 个提供者经 toxiproxy 原生进程（同 WSL）。
